meta.title: Constraints as Creative Fuel
meta.author: Mike Fullerton
meta.summary: Finite, well-chosen constraints increase creative output. The optimum is neither unlimited freedom nor excessive restriction — an inverted-U curve confirmed across 145 empirical studies.
references: Acar et al., Journal of Management, 45(1), 2019
Moreau & Dahl, Journal of Consumer Research, 32(1), 2005
Mehta, Zhu & Cheema, Journal of Consumer Research, 38(4), 2012
